name: dataceen
description: Dataceen as tools: a semantic model of a business becomes a running system, generated. Create a model, add sources, build it, define a scope per consumer, publish that scope as its own MCP server, GraphQL API and SDK, then have Dataceen build and host an application on it; the code is yours in a private repository. The build-with-dataceen skill and the /dataceen command lead the flow.
